description: Get the timestamped transcript of a YouTube video. Optionally limit to a time window to keep output small. Read it to decide which moments to clip.

from.description: Seconds (83) or "1:23" / "1:02:03.5". Negative = from the end ("-0:30"). For LIVE streams: "now", negative offsets from the live edge (-90), or ISO time ("2026-10-08T00:40:00Z"); roughly the last hour is available.
